title: seseli elatum subsp. heterophyllum
intro: Seseli elatum subsp. heterophyllum, commonly known as Sichuan fennel, is a plant species belonging to the carrot family (Apiaceae) that is native to the mountainous regions of Sichuan Province in China. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat a variety of health issues, including digestive problems and respiratory infections, due to its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Sichuan fennel include relieving cough and cold symptoms, reducing fever, and easing digestive discomfort, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents like volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of Seseli elatum subsp. heterophyllum have been found to possess antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
